proposed_widenings.name: passive item lifecycle end condition on hit
proposed_widenings.justification: The current magic-item passive surface can encode the attack and damage bonuses, but it cannot end the item's magical state after a successful hit.
proposed_widenings.evidence: "Once it hits a target, the ammunition is no longer magical."

notes: Authored as a rarity-variant magic-item collection with passive +N attack and damage bonuses on the specific ammunition piece. Typecheck and tracer passed. The on-hit loss of magic is omitted and recorded as the surface gap; the bundle-size/value text is catalog metadata, not core mechanics.
